title: Call sheet
description: The trigger input. Goldenrod fires when the call sheet for the next shoot day is issued — a document the production office already makes, so nobody has to remember to run anything. `scenes` are the locked scene numbers scheduled for that day; they are the entry point for pipeline step 1 (PARSE DAY).

shoot_date.description: The day these scenes shoot — tomorrow, relative to issue.

issued_at.description: When the production office issued it. This is the commitment boundary the check fires on.

revision_id.description: The script revision the day is scheduled against. The diff runs from this back to the prior revision.

prior_revision_id.description: The revision to diff against. Omit to use the most recent earlier revision on file.

scene_number.description: Locked scene number as printed on the pages. The stable coordinate — see the fact identity rule in db/clickhouse/schema.sql.
